name: CacciatoreDiOfferte - Orari Precisi

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * *'   # 10:00 italiane - VOGHION
    - cron: '0 13 * * *'  # 14:00 italiane - MYLEAD App + Giochi
    - cron: '0 15 * * *'  # 16:00 italiane - THUN
    - cron: '0 17 * * *'  # 18:00 italiane - ALIEXPRESS (NUOVO!)
    - cron: '0 19 * * *'  # 20:00 italiane - BAZTA
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  voghion-1000:
    if: github.event.schedule == '0 9 * * *' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.11' }
      - run: pip install requests || true
      - name: Voghion 10:00 - 1 messaggio pulito
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID }}
          AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID: ${{ secrets.AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID }}
          AWIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python caccia_store.py voghion
          python posta_store.py voghion

  mylead-1400:
    if: github.event.schedule == '0 13 * * *' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.11' }
      - run: pip install requests || true
      - name: MyLead 14:00 - 3 App + 3 Giochi
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID }}
          MYLEAD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MYLEAD_API_KEY }}
          MYLEAD_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MYLEAD_USERNAME }}
          MYLEAD_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MYLEAD_PASSWORD }}
          MYLEAD_TOP_MANUALE: ${{ secrets.MYLEAD_TOP_MANUALE }}
          MYLEAD_TOP_MANUALE_GIOCHI: ${{ secrets.MYLEAD_TOP_MANUALE_GIOCHI }}
        run: |
          python auto_mylead_tipo.py app
          python auto_mylead_tipo.py giochi

  thun-1600:
    if: github.event.schedule == '0 15 * * *' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.11' }
      - run: pip install requests || true
      - name: Thun 16:00 - 1 messaggio pulito
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID }}
          AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID: ${{ secrets.AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID }}
          AWIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python caccia_store.py thun
          python posta_store.py thun

  aliexpress-1800:
    if: github.event.schedule == '0 17 * * *' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.11' }
      - run: pip install requests || true
      - name: AliExpress 18:00 - 1 messaggio pulito
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID }}
          AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID: ${{ secrets.AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID }}
          AWIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python caccia_store.py aliexpress
          python posta_store.py aliexpress

  bazta-2000:
    if: github.event.schedule == '0 19 * * *' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with: { python-version: '3.11' }
      - run: pip install requests || true
      - name: Bazta 20:00 - 1 messaggio pulito
        env:
          TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID }}
          AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID: ${{ secrets.AWIN_PUBLISHER_ID }}
          AWIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python caccia_store.py bazta
          python posta_store.py bazta
